# List

List the kernel's parameters and which osapi manages.

Lists every parameter the kernel shows under /proc/sys, with its current value, as sysctl -a does, and marks the ones osapi manages. A prefix, such as net.ipv4, narrows it to that part of the tree. A parameter osapi manages that the kernel does not have right now, such as one whose module is not loaded, is listed with the value osapi wrote.

## What it refuses

| Call | Flags | Fails with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A prefix that is not a parameter name | `--prefix ../etc` | invalid sysctl key |

## Flags

| Flag | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--prefix` | Only this parameter and the ones under it, such as net.ipv4 |  |
| `-T, --target` | Target: `_any`, `_all`, hostname, or label (`group:web`) | `_all` |
| `-j, --json` | Print the API response as JSON | |
